name: Run-Length Encoding for Voxel Data
definition: A compression technique for voxel data (uint8 values 0-255) using run-length encoding, storing pairs of (count, value) in a Uint16Array.
summary: Run-Length Encoding for Voxel Data compresses consecutive uniform voxels into count-value pairs, enabling rays to skip homogeneous regions for faster, deterministic real-time decoding.
